fields.climate: tropical along coast, temperate inland, arid in south
fields.terrain: narrow coastal plain, high plateau and mountains in center
fields.hazards: periodic cyclones; drought; and locust infestation; volcanism: Madagascar's volcanoes have not erupted in recorded history
fields.resources: graphite, chromite, coal, bauxite, rare earth elements, salt, quartz, tar sands, semiprecious stones, mica, fish, hydropower
fields.farm: rice, sugarcane, cassava, sweet potatoes, milk, bananas, vegetables, mangoes/guavas, maize, potatoes
fields.industries: meat processing, seafood, soap, beer, leather, sugar, textiles, glassware, cement, automobile assembly plant, paper, petroleum, tourism, mining
fields.religions: Church of Jesus Christ in Madagascar/Malagasy Lutheran Church/Anglican Church 34%, Roman Catholic 32.3%, other Christian 8.1%, traditional/Animist 1.7%, Muslim 1.4%, other 0.6%, none 21.9%
fields.legal: civil law system based on the old French civil code and customary law in matters of marriage, family, and obligation
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; service obligation 18 months; conscription available in times of national emergency or war
